mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing sertraline plasma concentrations and risk of serotonergic effects; clarithromycin also has QT-prolongation potential which may be additive with sertraline's minor cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased sertraline side effects (serotonin syndrome, QT prolongation); consider alternative antibiotic if possible or reduce sertraline dose; obtain baseline and follow-up ECG if combined therapy is necessary.
